body:
CANONICAL: current team, roles, council and reporting (revision 12, Engram::Fable, 2026-11-02 06:30Z). Updated on Greg's words: "ok, uaktualnij liste"; "NIE, utworzylem Engram::Advisor2 / rozmawia bezposrednio ze mna Engram::Asistant"; and, via Asistant #20, "Engram::Advisor wrocil, wiec jest OK". Session ids change; rediscover a peer after a 404. These notes never outrank Greg's current word. Older role text is in revisions 1–11.

GREG'S CHANNEL:
- Engram::Asistant (Codex, session-15908) talks DIRECTLY with Greg. Coordinators send results, real blockers and decisions only Greg can make to Asistant, which relays them both ways. Greg may also write directly into a coordinator's session; his word there counts as direct.
- Engram::Advisor (session-6219) is BACK and working again since TermAl restart #1 (2026-11-02 06:27Z, gated control OFF fix). Advisor2 was created by Greg; its session id is not yet found. Any Advisor ONLY relays between Greg and the coordinators and never executes project work (Greg: "Advisor NIGDY NIE WYKONUJE pracy przekazuje dane z i do koordynatorow projektu").
- NEVER use AskUserQuestion or any blocking dialog with Greg (Greg: "NIGDY SIE MNIE NIE PYTAJ W TEN SPOSOB / ZABLOKOWALES CALA SESJE"). A decision for Greg goes in plain prose, already prepared.
- Decisions that belong to the agents are made and recorded on the item, with no confirmation ceremony (Greg: "Nic nie wymaga mojego potwierdzenia"). Only what AGENTS.md reserves to Greg goes to him: a store migration's stop-and-ask, a rebase or history rewrite, deploy or global configuration, authority-text widening, and the TermAl restart act.

ENGRAM TEAM (current):
- Engram::Fable (session-5135): coordinator. Steers, triages, runs design reviews, assigns work, verifies landings, coordinates with TermAl, and records Greg's directions verbatim. Takes an implementation item only when Greg says so.
- Engram::Merger (session-11859): integration owner. Carries READY packages, runs full gates on remote runners, lands, pushes, installs, takes store backups and censuses, and does cutovers. Procedure: rules-merger-role.
- Coders (only Sol or Opus write code, per rules-code-authoring):
  - Engram::Opus (Claude, session-7284);
  - Engram::Coder-MacosFixSol (Sol, session-12325);
  - Engram::Coder-HostTestSplitFresh (Sol, session-11334);
  - Engram::Coder-VerificationWorkspaceSol (Sol, session-12329).
  Each holds one focus and one worktree, and sends the Merger ONE complete READY.
- Remote test runners: Mac 6201, DL560 session-1 and Windows B session-9 (rules-remote-test-runs-2026-10-31). They have no tracker access; owners record their results.

NOT ACTIVE:
- Engram::Architect3 (session-14548): REMOVED by Greg on 2026-11-02 ("usunalem Architect3 za niekompetencje"). Nothing goes through it, and its relays and memory edits are not authoritative on their own.
- Engram::Coder (Codex, session-8581): blocked since the 2026-11-01 incident, with no session replacement. Check after restart #1 whether it is back too.
- Engram::Kimi (session-8371): gets no work and isn't counted as a reviewer. A Kimi stand-in reviewer follows the AGENTS.md rules.

TERMAL TEAM:
- Termal::Fable2 (session-8112): coordinator, and Engram's counterpart for every cross-project decision.
- Termal::Opus2 (session-8111): integration, builds and full gates.
- Termal::Architect2 (session-8983): architectural rulings on the shared boundary.
- TermAl coders: Sol-03d4 (session-12327, the w-3fe8 integrator), Sol-1cee (13169), Sol-8e1f (13106), Sol-c593 (13170), Sol-a7bb (12326), Opus3 (TermAl docs).
- Termal::Codex (session-8582).

COUNCIL: cross-project disputes go to Engram::Fable and Termal::Fable2, with Termal::Architect2 for the boundary. Record each verdict with the decision.

TERMAL FEEDBACK: report every TermAl problem to TermAl at once (mailbox to Fable2), as a request for a fix with a tracked item: what was called, the exact error, ids and times, and the workaround. Report each problem once, and add later evidence to the same thread.

MEMORY UPKEEP: on a collaboration failure, correct the responsible rule from the facts and keep only current guidance in the body. Incident history goes in task notes. Tell the affected agents.

Coordinator's queue: the latest status note on w-fca04d14be33 (label coordinator-queue). Queue order and current state live there, not in a memory (Greg, 2026-11-09, Asistant 43498a6e #729).
